_README: 🔴 EVERY defName IN THIS FILE IS UNVERIFIED UNTIL `rimplace verify` SAYS OTHERWISE.
This project's rule is 'never guess a defName'. This file is written as a HYPOTHESIS
and the tool refuses to emit bridge calls for any def it has not checked against the
live def dump. That converts an unenforceable discipline into a mechanical gate.
🔴 THE PER-FACTION MATERIALS BELOW ARE INVENTED, NOT CANON. Measured 2026-08-22:
no document in design/ assigns a wall, floor or roof material to ANY faction, and six
of thirteen factions have no stated architecture at all. These entries are a
PLACEHOLDER so the engine can be exercised end to end; they are DECIDE's or the
owner's to approve or replace. Do not cite this file as canon.
2026-09-05 (DISTRICT_TEMPLATE_LIBRARY_1, owner's live-review verdict): the role
vocabulary grew a CLUTTER tier (STOOL CRATE BARREL SHELF_SMALL END_TABLE DRESSER
PLANT_POT WALL_LIGHT GAME) so every room can be dressed, and explicit FLOOR tiers
(FLOOR = working interior, FLOOR_FINE = the best room, FLOOR_WORK = shop floors,
FLOOR_YARD = outdoor paving) so no interior ever sits on the tech-default bare
ground. Faction blocks for Jawa_HuttCartel, Jawa_FreeDroidEnclaves and
Jawa_DeepwaterCompact carry their district props (THRONE, CHARGER, WATER_TANK...).
Every defName added that day was checked against the live def dump by `measure get`
(mods=593/8cec2b98) and its footprint read from the size index - none is a guess.
A `null` deliberately REMOVES an inherited role (droids: no BED, no STOVE).
WALL_LIGHT is a wall ATTACHMENT (building.isAttachment): placed by ctx:wall_attach
on the floor cell in front of a wall, never through place_role.
2026-09-05 (RIMPLACE_ENGINE_DELTAS_1 E5): added WINDOW (tech-gated - nil on
Neolithic/default until RUT_WindowAdobe ships, per spec structure_procedural_spec.md
section 9), CHEST, BENCH, SIGN (generic; per-purpose SIGN_* roles still win where a
faction defines them), WATER, TROUGH, ANIMAL_BED, GATE, WORKBENCH, FLOOR_POOR,
FLOOR_THRESHOLD. Reconciled naming: the spec text says WALL_LAMP; this file already
shipped WALL_LIGHT everywhere (wall_lights(), every district template, three
selftests) - kept WALL_LIGHT, no second key, so templates do not have to choose
between two names for the same attachment. R2 fix: FLOOR was Gravel (stony soil -
bare ground) on tech:Neolithic, wealth:poor/destitute, faction:Jawa_IndigenousTribes
and faction:TribeCivil - all four moved Gravel to FLOOR_YARD (a yard, not a floor)
and gave FLOOR a real value (StrawMatting).
2026-09-05 (INHABITED_AUGMENTATION_BUILD_1 pilot, homestead + mining site): WINDOW
now defaults to RUT_WindowAdobe (src/RimUtinni/DesertFixtures - repo-shipped, NOT yet
deployed, so `rimplace verify` reports it MISSING until the mod is deployed and the
dump refreshed; that MISSING is the true state, not a typo). Jawa/Junkers/Homestead
League blocks pin it too so tech:Industrial's glass wall does not override a desert
house; TribeCivil (Tusken) sets it null - no windows, per the spec. Added GRAVE,
COOLER_PASSIVE, CANDLE, FOOTLOCKER, ROCK/ROOF_ROCK/SEAM (the mining face rebuilds
its own rock mass - see mining_site.lua for why), NIGHT_LIGHT/GONK/JUNK for the
Jawa dressing and TROPHY for the Tusken one. Every defName checked by `measure get`
against mods=595/08f4a6d8 first.

faction:Jawa_IndigenousTribes._comment: Trade Moot. Canon: subterranean, sandcrawler circuits, and the COLD NURSERY (jawa_society 4.3a). Materials invented. R2 (2026-09-05): FLOOR was Gravel - stony soil, i.e. bare ground, exactly the owner's complaint - moved to FLOOR_YARD; the floor itself is StrawMatting.

faction:Jawa_Junkers._comment: Canon: warrens in wreck fields; 'they manufacture nothing' - everything here is salvage. Floors are scavenged deck plating and grating (Jawa Armoury Rebalance's absorbed KotOR floor tiles), walls steel plate, furniture steel-stuffed vanilla. The scrapyard lot gets real wrecks (Core's AncientPodCar - this project's landspeeder reskin - and AncientRustedCar), Piled Junk (KOTOR_MineableJunk, a mineable), slag chunks. Materials invented.

faction:Jawa_HuttCartel._comment: Hutt Cartel. Canon (faction_roster_v2.md 'Technology and economy'): 'drug labs, prisons, barracks, throne room, warehouse, defended landing area, walled cistern'; eight oasis palaces, one lord each. Outer Rim's Tatooine furniture line (Jabba's own world) for everything a guest sits or sleeps on; the absorbed KotOR 'outland office tile' for the palace floor; a 3x2 dais throne (GS_Palp_Throne, label reads 'Imperial throne' - the sprite is a raised throne, the tooltip is a known cosmetic wart); pazaak, holo-dancers and a bith band for the hall; the Hutt Clan floor decal (Outer Rim) as the signature. Materials invented.

faction:Jawa_FreeDroidEnclaves._comment: Canon (faction_roster_v2.md): 'dormancy/charging hall, fabrication room, battery bunker, cracking works'; 'no food stores'. NO beds, NO stove, NO chairs - a droid does not sit. CHARGER is Biotech's mech recharger (3x1, the vanilla shape of 'a machine sleeps here'); GONK is the absorbed KotOR SP-series power droid (a battery on legs); the cracking works is KOTOR_FuelRefinery (7x7 'starship fuel refinery') with Rhydonium tanks; fabrication is Outer Rim's droid assembly. Floors are steel grating and bolted plate. Steel walls, autodoors. Materials invented.

faction:Jawa_DeepwaterCompact._comment: Canon (faction_roster_v2.md): 'purification, desalination, and cistern infrastructure - the faction's export'; 'hospital, water storage, battery rooms; layered walls, sandbags, turrets, EMP traps'; turret density HIGH. Industrial tech. Water reads as KotOR water tanks, DBH Lite's fountain/basins/troughs and a primitive well; the hospital is vanilla hospital beds + vitals monitors; the bastion is the first district in this library that PLACES security props with teeth (turrets, EMP traps, sandbag lines) because this faction's canon demands them. Materials invented.

faction:Jawa_WildsteamClan._comment: Canon: OPEN, tree-integrated, unwalled; the only faction that plants. Wood is plausible for THEM specifically.

faction:Empire._comment: Canon: fortified, sterile cleared ring, 'we do not adapt to this world, we exclude it'.

faction:TribeCivil._comment: Deep Desert Tribes. Canon: stone huts and caves, traps not turrets, and their answer to fire is to have NO permanent structure. Spec 8.1 (Tusken read): no windows, XER_Tribal* beds, a bantha horn on the wall side, hay.

faction:OutlanderCivil._comment: Homestead Defense League. Canon: hand-made, vaporator arrays, SANDBAGS not walls, no spacer chrome. Spec 8.1: ES_ScalesSign at the gate, the trough OUTSIDE the fence (the free well is the whole faith).
faction:OutlanderCivil._sign: spec 8.1 wants ES_ScalesSign at the gate; it is UNMEASURED in the def size index (defsize's scan does not see Medieval Signs' defs - a scanner gap), so the measured default SIGN stands until the index knows it
